The only podcasts I've ever listened to have been board game related podcasts.  I had to wait for my wife to run some errands and my daughter to be asleep, but I managed to listen.  Very interesting stuff.  

 

Skyscraper sounds really cool mechanically.  I don't think anyone predicted she would work the way that Christopher describes her.  As for the reveal of new villains:

 

SPOILERS BELOW

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

I would guess that Progeny will be The Scholar's nemesis bases on the fact that it changes forms.  He talked about Deadline and Warfang (couldn't make out the first name) who are the reptilian and female villains on the WotC box respectively.  At first I assumed Warfang would be Skyscraper's nemesis and Deadline would be Captain Cosmic's, but now I think it could be the opposite.  IIRC, Christopher mentioned that it's interesting who brings Skyscraper to Earth.  I wonder if Deadline brings Skyscraper to Earth as a "herald" (for lack of a better word) and she ends up being the Silver Surfer to his Galactus.

Deadline: Mankind is on a path of destruction, even you "heroes" cannot deny this. I, regrettably, must put a stop to all of this in order to avoid it.
